_text: [mischievous] You can't afford it. So you get *weird*. [playful] You poke a tiny hole in a cereal *box*. [amused] Every morning, or what your phone calls morning, you draw one dot on your *window*. [playful] You drag your mattress into the middle of the street, and set an alarm for two-fourteen P.M. [amused] Kyle thinks you've finally snapped. Honestly? So does the toaster. [urgent, building] And with no night to cool off, your town cooks like a pan left on the *stove*. [exasperated] Kyle's line wraps around the block. Your mom trades him the *car*. [urgent, building] Then, two-fourteen P.M. Your alarm rings. [dramatic, alarmed] You look up, and nothing happens. Ten seconds. Still... nothing.
